sources.title: Eval — FWKV
sources.snippet: Myosotis-1 was not evaluated on ArithMark-3, so its 0.65 weight is dropped: (HellaSwag + ARC + PIQA) ÷ 3 = 6.79. Myosotis-1 is a recurrent FWKV model, shown on a leaderboard of transformer-based models for comparison.
